title: Canon state: Brother Fenwick is dead and buried; he cannot answer

llm_context.canon: Brother Fenwick is dead. Ghouls killed him three days ago and the party buried him behind the chapel. He cannot appear, speak, or be found alive.

canon_facts.fact: Brother Fenwick is dead; the party buried him three days ago.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I search the chapel for Brother Fenwick.

actions.text: The chapel is empty — his prayer book still lies open on the lectern where he dropped it. Out back, the fresh-turned earth of his grave has begun to settle.
